**Finding: Compliant (no audit rights bind us).**

The agreement contains no audit, inspection, verification, records-examination or system-access right in TrueLink's favor. The only verification-type provisions run in our direction:

- **§6 (p0047)** — Client is entitled to supporting documentation for charges and to contest them.
- **§2(e) (p0037)** — Client has real-time access to Interface usage statistics and raw log files.
- **§8 (p0053, p0058)** — Client covenants (access restriction, anti-spam technical mechanisms) impose no audit right; the spam provision is an operational control on the hosted Interface, not an examination of our records or systems.

Because the absence of any Vendor audit right is better than the preferred position (annual, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor cost, no system access), no clause is required and no redline was proposed — inserting audit language would only create an obligation against us.
